## 简体中文

- 在分流规则集中新增不可删除的「CN 前置分流」，与「中国大陆域名」并列，简易和完整模式均可使用；移除自动网络切换页的旧开关。
- 默认不启用，分流方式默认「直连路由」：CN IP 经物理出口直连，不进入 TUN；其他公网流量进入 TUN 后继续分流。
- 支持选择「代理」及实际代理节点：不安装 CN 物理直连路由，CN 流量进入 TUN 后优先使用专用代理组，普通域名规则继续处理其他流量。
- 两种模式均使用真实 IP DNS，沿用路由更新、网络切换、失败清理和启动恢复机制。启用或修改分流方式后需重启核心。
- 已通过现有回归测试、Rust 格式检查与 Clippy、仓库 lint 和类型检查；macOS、Windows 原生路由写入及真实流量抓包仍待验收。

## English

- Add an undeletable CN pre-routing built-in beside Mainland China domains in the routing rule sets, available in both simple and advanced views. Remove the old switch from automatic network switching.
- Disabled by default, with Direct system route selected: CN IPs use the physical uplink without entering TUN; other public traffic enters TUN for further routing.
- Support Proxy mode and selection of actual proxy nodes. No physical CN bypass routes are installed; CN traffic enters TUN and uses its dedicated proxy group before ordinary domain rules, which continue to handle other traffic.
- Both modes use real-IP DNS and retain route updates, network switching, failure cleanup, and startup recovery. Restart the core after enabling or changing the routing mode.
- Passed existing regression tests, Rust formatting and Clippy, repository lint, and type checks. Native route writes and live packet-capture acceptance on macOS and Windows remain to be verified.
